headline: Walking and biking priorities for City Council, plus a candidate survey for mayoral and council races.
summary: The council will present findings from the South and East District forums and begin drafting walking and biking recommendations for City Council. Last year's candidate surveys will be reviewed, and a refined survey will be prepared for mayoral and city council candidates.
location: DPW conference room at 645 Pine Street (in person) or Zoom (virtual)
item_action_words: The Walk/Bike Council will present their findings
